text: The Auditor General’s 2026 Annual Work Plan[1] included a project on continuous controls monitoring of selected payroll-related expenses at the City. The objective of this continuous controls monitoring, a non-audit project, was to highlight unusual transactions and exceptions in payroll-related expenses, including emerging trends, and areas where internal controls may need to be strengthened. The continuous controls monitoring project uses an exception-based analytics approach to review payroll transactions and trends over multiple years.
